sens_en: to give, to present as a gift
origine_fr: À gauche, 贝, la monnaie ; à droite, 曾, qui donnait le son mais se lit le plus souvent céng. C'est s'offrir des objets précieux. Le sens est resté : « offrir, faire cadeau de ».
origine_en: On the left, 贝, money; on the right, 曾, which gave the sound but is usually read céng. It means giving each other precious things. The meaning has stayed: “to give as a present”.

phrase.pinyin: Zhè běn shū shì tā zèng gěi wǒ de.
phrase.fr: C'est lui qui m'a offert ce livre.
phrase.en: He gave me this book as a gift.
